tasks.subject: Task 1: Expose app internals to the test shim
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Tests can call activeSet(), logActiveSet(), skipSet(), curDay(), getExerciseHistory(), and commitEdit() directly instead of inferring behavior from rendered HTML.

**Files:**
- Modify: `tools/app-shim.js:180-192` (eval tail), `tools/app-shim.js:50-66` (makeElement)
- Test: `tools/app-shim.test.js`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] withApp exposes activeSet, logActiveSet, skipSet, curDay, getExerciseHistory as functions.
- [ ] commitEdit is exposed behind a typeof guard (does not exist until Task 7).
- [ ] The element stub answers select() without throwing.
- [ ] Existing tests still pass unchanged.

**Verify:** `node --test tools/*.test.js` -> all tests pass.

**Steps:**
1. Add the two new tests. 2. Confirm failure. 3. Add select() to makeElement. 4. Extend the eval tail. 5. Re-run + full suite. 6. Commit with explicit pathspec.

- Test: `tools/select-exercise.test.js`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] Logging the last incomplete set clears view.selectedExId.
- [ ] Logging a non-final set KEEPS the selection.
- [ ] Skipping the last incomplete set clears the selection.
- [ ] Skip clearing works for a SWAPPED exercise (resolved id mapped back to original).
- [ ] Un-skipping does not clear the selection.
- [ ] Completing a different exercise never clears the selection.

**Verify:** `node --test tools/select-exercise.test.js` -> 16 tests pass.

**Steps:**
1. Append 6 tests. 2. Confirm failure. 3. Add hasPendingSet. 4. Clear in logActiveSet via act.orig.id. 5. Replace skipSet with resolved->original mapping. 6. Re-run + node --check + full suite. 7. Commit.

tasks.subject: Task 7: Inline numeric entry for weight and reps
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Tapping either value turns it into a numeric input that survives the 500ms render loop, commits on Enter/blur/change, and cancels on Escape.

**Files:**
- Modify: `index.html:190-206` (CSS .step-in), `index.html:2966` (view init), `index.html:3373` (renderBottomBar guard + focus), bottom-bar markup, click handler, new commitEdit + document listeners
- Test: `tools/reps.test.js`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] view.editing starts null; editw/editr set it.
- [ ] The FIRST render emits the input; subsequent renders leave innerHTML byte-identical.
- [ ] The freeze guard reads el.innerHTML, NOT getElementById (the shim never returns null and would freeze forever).
- [ ] Clearing view.editing unfreezes the bar.
- [ ] commitEdit applies valid numbers and clears editing.
- [ ] Invalid or empty input leaves the pending value unchanged.
- [ ] Negative clamps to zero; reps parseInt, weight parseFloat.
- [ ] A second commit on the same edit is a no-op (change + focusout both fire on blur).
- [ ] Any non-edit action clears view.editing (one blanket line at the top of the handler).
- [ ] Weight inputmode=decimal, reps inputmode=numeric.

**Verify:** `node --test tools/reps.test.js` -> 22 tests pass.

**Steps:**
1. Append 8 test blocks. 2. Confirm failure. 3. Add editing to view. 4. Add freeze guard + focus/select. 5. Replace step-v divs with editable versions. 6. Add commitEdit + change/focusout/keydown listeners. 7. Add blanket clear + editw/editr branches. 8. Add .step-in CSS. 9. Re-run + node --check + full suite. 10. Commit.

See `docs/superpowers/plans/2026-07-23-out-of-order-logging-and-reps.md` for exact code.
